title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management: automatic preservation of deleted content for high-risk users
summary: Held because the cost discussion limits the known cost to administrative effort, although the cited Microsoft documentation says retained SharePoint and OneDrive content consumes storage quota and may require more storage. The roadmap facts, documented retention behaviour and control paths otherwise check out.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans automatic retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user's insider risk level.
claims.quote: The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user's insider risk level.

claims.claim: Adaptive Protection moves users in and out of policies as their insider risk levels change.
claims.quote: integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The pages read publish no separate price, meter or per-use charge for this automatic retention label.
claims.quote: Searched: Adaptive Protection data lifecycle management price meter storage. Read retention, Adaptive Protection and Purview service description; no separate label price or usage meter found. This does not establish that retained content has no storage implications.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; rationale: cost; Open questions
claims.claim: The only cost the pages show is administrative time, with storage charges left entirely as a question about future plans.
claims.quote: Because the Preservation Hold library is included in the site's storage quota, you might need to increase your storage when you use retention settings for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Microsoft 365 groups.
claims.fix: Replace the final sentence of Cost and licensing with: 'Plan for admin time to review the setting, brief records and legal owners, and monitor audit events. Retained SharePoint and OneDrive content also counts against the site's storage quota, and Microsoft says storage might need to be increased.' In the cost rationale, replace 'The only cost the pages show is admin time' with 'Plan for admin time and storage headroom for retained SharePoint and OneDrive content'. In Open questions, change 'any meter or storage charge planned' to 'a separate integration-specific meter planned'. Cite the already-listed https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/retention; do not infer a storage price or mandatory storage purchase.
